Rules / Formatting

SK0205 The null check is not arranged

skala arrange would change the configured null-checking pattern.

CategoryFormatting
Default severitysuggestion
ScopeSemantic
Needs a compilationyes
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileyes
Fixno
Language version floorC# 9.0
Since2.0

Why

Equality operators may be overloaded, so changing x != null into a pattern is not merely textual. The arranger resolves the operator and runs its diagnostic-delta safety check before keeping the rewrite.

Example

Instead of:

if (value != null) Use(value);

Write:

if (value is not null) Use(value);

When it does not fire

Types whose equality operator could change the meaning are left alone.

Configuration

  • resharper_csharp_null_checking_pattern_style
